Team penalized after wheel violation

Officials penalized a racing team after a wheel detached during Sunday's event. The rear tire changer and jack operator will miss the next two rounds after inspectors found that the wheel had not been attached in accordance with the series rulebook. The incident caused a caution and resulted in an additional on-track penalty for the driver.

Despite losing time during the caution period, the driver recovered to finish second. The team said it would review its pit-stop procedure before the next race and prepare substitute crew members for both suspended positions. No additional penalties were announced for the driver or car.
